name: p4-native
description: The host layer of ezexe/p4: at a session's start it works out what this host is and can do, the desktop app or a terminal, interactive or scripted, the Claude Code version and the tools that answer here, and keeps that map in the project's .claude/p4 store, where the session and the other p4 plugins read it, and when the Claude Code version changes it probes each condition that blocked a decision and tells the session once what changed, it names each command and tool of a new build that no p4 plugin has weighed, it hands one line when a session does by hand what a native feature of this host does, each such call can be refused by an option of its own, and those options and two native features are off by default.

push.title: Push when a turn ends
push.description: Calls Claude Code's PushNotification tool when a turn ends in a session ezexe is at, so ezexe hears that the session waits or is done. Off in a scripted run and in a session another session started.

status.title: Status line with the host
status.description: Pins one line under the prompt that names the host, whether the session is interactive or scripted, and the Claude Code version.

hints.title: One line at a miss
hints.description: Hands a session one line of context when it does by hand what a native feature of this host does, once for each situation in a session. It refuses no call: each `refuse_` option below does that for one situation.

refuse_gh_run_polled_in_a_loop.title: Refuse: gh run polled in a loop
refuse_gh_run_polled_in_a_loop.description: A shell loop polled `gh run list` and slept between the polls. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names what to run in its place.

refuse_gh_run_list_short_commit.title: Refuse: gh run list short commit
refuse_gh_run_list_short_commit.description: `gh run list --commit` was given a short commit hash and listed nothing. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names what to run in its place.

refuse_transcript_read_from_disk.title: Refuse: transcript read from disk
refuse_transcript_read_from_disk.description: A session read another session's transcript file from disk. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__list_events`, `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__search_session_transcripts`, `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__export_transcript`, `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__get_session`, `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__get_usage`.

refuse_file_read_by_a_shell.title: Refuse: file read by a shell
refuse_file_read_by_a_shell.description: A shell command prints one file with `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `less`, `more`, `type` or `Get-Content`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Read`.

refuse_files_found_by_a_shell.title: Refuse: files found by a shell
refuse_files_found_by_a_shell.description: A shell command lists files by name with `find`, `ls -R`, `dir /s` or `Get-ChildItem -Recurse`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Glob`.

refuse_text_searched_by_a_shell.title: Refuse: text searched by a shell
refuse_text_searched_by_a_shell.description: A shell command searches file contents with `grep`, `rg`, `findstr` or `Select-String` at the head of a pipeline. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Grep`.

refuse_file_edited_by_a_shell.title: Refuse: file edited by a shell
refuse_file_edited_by_a_shell.description: A shell command changes a file in place with `sed -i`, `perl -pi`, `awk -i inplace` or `-replace` piped to `Set-Content`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Edit`.

refuse_file_written_by_a_shell.title: Refuse: file written by a shell
refuse_file_written_by_a_shell.description: A shell command writes text into a file with `echo` or `printf` and a redirect, a heredoc, `Set-Content` or `Add-Content`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Write`.

refuse_notebook_edited_as_a_file.title: Refuse: notebook edited as a file
refuse_notebook_edited_as_a_file.description: An `Edit` or `Write` call changes a Jupyter notebook as a text file. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `NotebookEdit`.

refuse_powershell_run_from_bash.title: Refuse: powershell run from bash
refuse_powershell_run_from_bash.description: A `Bash` call runs `powershell` or `pwsh` with a command of its own. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `PowerShell`.

refuse_bash_run_from_powershell.title: Refuse: bash run from powershell
refuse_bash_run_from_powershell.description: A `PowerShell` call runs `bash`, `sh` or `wsl` with a command of its own. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Bash`.

refuse_page_fetched_by_a_shell.title: Refuse: page fetched by a shell
refuse_page_fetched_by_a_shell.description: A shell command gets a public web page with `curl`, `wget`, `Invoke-WebRequest` or `Invoke-RestMethod`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `WebFetch`.

refuse_search_engine_fetched.title: Refuse: search engine fetched
refuse_search_engine_fetched.description: A shell command or a `WebFetch` call gets a search engine's results page. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `WebSearch`.

refuse_claude_run_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: claude run in a shell
refuse_claude_run_in_a_shell.description: A `Bash` or `PowerShell` call starts a scripted Claude Code run with `claude -p`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Agent`, `mcp__ccd_session__start_session`.

refuse_claude_runs_fanned_out_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: claude runs fanned out in a shell
refuse_claude_runs_fanned_out_in_a_shell.description: A shell command starts several scripted Claude Code runs, in a loop or side by side. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Workflow`.

refuse_session_messaged_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: session messaged in a shell
refuse_session_messaged_in_a_shell.description: A shell command sends a prompt into a session that exists, with `claude --resume` or `--continue` and `-p`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__send_message`.

refuse_session_resumed_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: session resumed in a shell
refuse_session_resumed_in_a_shell.description: A shell command resumes or forks a session with `claude --resume`, `--continue` or `--fork-session`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/resume`, `/fork`.

refuse_page_opened_from_a_shell.title: Refuse: page opened from a shell
refuse_page_opened_from_a_shell.description: A shell command opens an HTML file in a browser with `start`, `open`, `xdg-open` or `Invoke-Item`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Artifact`.

refuse_sessions_found_by_their_processes.title: Refuse: sessions found by their processes
refuse_sessions_found_by_their_processes.description: A shell command lists the machine's processes and picks out Claude Code's. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `ListAgents`, `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__list_sessions`, `/list-agents`.

refuse_notification_raised_from_a_shell.title: Refuse: notification raised from a shell
refuse_notification_raised_from_a_shell.description: A shell command raises a notification of the system or rings its bell. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `PushNotification`.

refuse_long_sleep_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: long sleep in a shell
refuse_long_sleep_in_a_shell.description: A shell command sleeps for a minute or longer. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `ScheduleWakeup`.

refuse_loop_with_a_sleep_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: loop with a sleep in a shell
refuse_loop_with_a_sleep_in_a_shell.description: A shell loop runs a step again and again with a sleep between. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/loop`.

refuse_skill_read_as_a_file.title: Refuse: skill read as a file
refuse_skill_read_as_a_file.description: A `Read` call or a shell command prints a skill's `SKILL.md`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `Skill`.

refuse_process_killed_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: process killed in a shell
refuse_process_killed_in_a_shell.description: A shell command stops a process with `kill`, `pkill`, `taskkill` or `Stop-Process`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `TaskStop`, `mcp__terminal__stop_terminal_tab`, `mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__stop_session`.

refuse_backup_copy_made_by_hand.title: Refuse: backup copy made by hand
refuse_backup_copy_made_by_hand.description: A shell command copies a file to a `.bak`, `.orig`, `.old` or `.backup` beside it. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/rewind`, `Checkpoints`.

refuse_worktree_removed_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: worktree removed in a shell
refuse_worktree_removed_in_a_shell.description: A shell command removes a git worktree, or a folder under `.claude/worktrees`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `mcp__ccd_host__discard_kept_worktree`, `mcp__ccd_host__clean_up_worktrees`.

refuse_store_measured_in_a_shell.title: Refuse: store measured in a shell
refuse_store_measured_in_a_shell.description: A shell command adds up the size of a `.claude` folder with `du` or `Measure-Object`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `mcp__ccd_host__get_storage_usage`.

refuse_transcript_copied_by_hand.title: Refuse: transcript copied by hand
refuse_transcript_copied_by_hand.description: A shell command copies this session's own transcript file. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/export`.

refuse_transcript_measured_by_hand.title: Refuse: transcript measured by hand
refuse_transcript_measured_by_hand.description: A shell command measures this session's own transcript file to tell how full the conversation is. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/context`.

refuse_model_set_by_hand.title: Refuse: model set by hand
refuse_model_set_by_hand.description: An edit of a settings file sets `model` or `effortLevel`, or a shell command sets `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/model`.

refuse_store_file_removed_by_hand.title: Refuse: store file removed by hand
refuse_store_file_removed_by_hand.description: A shell command deletes a file of the project's `.claude/p4` store, or an edit changes its `expires.json`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/lifetime`.

refuse_plugin_files_changed_by_hand.title: Refuse: plugin files changed by hand
refuse_plugin_files_changed_by_hand.description: A shell command or an edit changes the installed plugins' files under `.claude/plugins`. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/plugin`, `/reload-plugins`.

refuse_release_notes_fetched_by_hand.title: Refuse: release notes fetched by hand
refuse_release_notes_fetched_by_hand.description: A shell command or a `WebFetch` call gets Claude Code's changelog or its package page. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/release-notes`.

refuse_review_handed_to_an_agent.title: Refuse: review handed to an agent
refuse_review_handed_to_an_agent.description: An `Agent` call asks a subagent to review a code change. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `/code-review`, `/review`.

refuse_task_list_kept_by_another_tool.title: Refuse: task list kept by another tool
refuse_task_list_kept_by_another_tool.description: A `TaskCreate` or `TodoWrite` call keeps a task list in a session of the desktop app. With this on, the call is refused before it runs and the refusal names `mcp__ccd_turn__update_plan`.
